integrity: Proof reconstructs the local intersection constraints and uses explicitly cited published free-curve and orbifold inequalities. Standalone exact integer verification accompanies the proof; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only a necessary profile for complex free arrangements of smooth cubics and lines with A1, D4, A5 singularities is proved; existence of the surviving profile and cases with other singularities are not resolved. Prior priority is not independently certified.
title: A single possible free degree-nine cubic–line incidence profile
